core_obligations: The starting morphism (proof lines 3115-3126): X_n = g_{n!}K_n by cartesianness; the map K_0 -> K'_0 induces X_0 -> K' by the adjunction; the compatibility of the system morphism makes the composition X_1 -> X_0 -> K' zero (the author marks the unpacking 'omitted' - see notes).

Inductive lifting (lines 3126-3148): from the triangle X_{n+1}[n] -> Y_n[n] -> Y_{n+1}[n+1] -> X_{n+1}[n+1] the exact sequence Hom(Y_{n+1}[n+1], K') -> Hom(Y_n[n], K') -> Hom(X_{n+1}[n], K') has last term Hom(K_{n+1}[n], K'_{n+1}) = 0 by assumption (2) for n >= 1; by induction a compatible system of maps Y_n[n] -> K' exists, reducing on Y_0 to the given X_0 -> K'.

The resulting morphism and its components (lines 3150-3172): the compatible system assembles into gamma : K = hocolim Y_n[n] -> K' whose restriction to C_0 is the given K_0 -> K'_0; since K is cartesian the components gamma_n are determined by gamma_0 through the transition isomorphisms (see notes), and hence {gamma_n} is exactly the given morphism of simplicial systems.
proof_roadmap: Identify X_n = g_{n!}K_n and start the lifting from the degree-zero component.
Run the Postnikov induction: the vanishing assumption (2) kills the obstruction group at every step.
Assemble gamma via the homotopy colimit and identify its components with the given system maps.
difficulty_reason: Lifting lemma (statement 3103-3113, proof 3115-3172): the dual companion of the cartesian-object existence theorem - the inductive Postnikov lifting is carried out in full with exact sequences and the vanishing hypothesis, and the assembly via hocolim is explicit; two short spots (an auxiliary vanishing unpacking and the closing determination argument) are recorded in the notes. H2: derived-category induction in the style of the chapter's Postnikov arguments.
